description:
Hi
 
 I have Opportunity with one of my client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested please forward me your updated resume along with your contact details to discuss further. 

 Role: Hybrid Developer ( ionic, Angular Consultant )
 Duration: Full Time / Permanent 
 Location: Columbus, Ohio 


 Job Summary: 
 
 
 ionic, angular experience with phonegap preferred. 
 Experience in HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Java, Ecode exp. 
 Hands on dev exp in JS, Native UI Views, Controllers, Web Components, Mixing Native and Web code. 
 will be trained and working as IBM Worklight  Middleware  dev 

 Job Details:
 
 
 Track record in development of frontends and he/she  should have the strong knowledge on the web/mobile  applications  
 Knowledge of HTML5, especially Javascript. Solid  Javascript/HTML5 experience (5+ years)
 AngularJS, PhoneGap\Cordova, Sass, Git\Gulp experience. 
 Choice would be phonegap / ionic, angular experience 
 Ability to work collaboratively with others and as part  of a team member  Mobile frameworks such as Ionic  Strong passion for mobile technology  IBM Work light experience is a plus 
 Understand end to end ecosystems that affect mobile  client development
 Cordova/Phonegap experience 
 Karma/Jasimine/Protractor testing experience 
 Native iOS and/or Android experience is a huge plus 
 (iOS>Android) 
 Must have a clear understanding and hands on experience  with integrating REST services and plugins 
 
 
 Role & Responsibilities: Software development Experience.
 Adherence to industry best practices and processes, with enhanced quality of delivery.
 Should have good communication skills.

 

 •Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
